SLEEPING HEART RATE REMAINS THE ONE MARKER THAT WILL NOT SETTLE — 66 raw, low 57, smoothed 66.3 against 62.3, and it has now been above its baseline for weeks; I weight it less than usual this morning because the two markers that moved yesterday have both come back and the index is otherwise ordinary. FORM IS THE ONE NUMBER I WILL NOT QUOTE AT YOU TODAY: yesterday's row reads ctl 56.09 minus atl 97.54, but that atl still contains CAe19's planned 179 for a ride that was never ridden — the stale event was only cleaned off the calendar at 06:00 this morning, actual load on the day was 77, and the honest statement is that real fatigue went DOWN on Saturday, not up. THE CLASSIC FAILURE IS FINISHING THE LAST ZONE 2 BLOCK AND NEVER COMING BACK DOWN, which turns the last half hour into Zone X and costs the week its ratio on the final day. My call is to run all 105 as written, and if the Zone 2 blocks ask for more than they should, take them at the slow end at 5:45 and let the Zone 1 carry the session — the volume is the point today, not the pace.
